caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular woven textile with a repetitive, structured design. The textile is composed of parallel horizontal rows in a brownish-tan color, creating a ridged texture across its surface. Down the center of the textile runs a vertical line of evenly spaced rectangular shapes in a darker blueish-black color, which appear to be woven into the lighter background. The edges of the textile are slightly irregular, particularly along the right side, where the yarn appears chunky and rounded. The drawing is centered on a plain, light beige background, and the artist's signature appears in the lower right portion of the image.
title: Woven Mat
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
